svg.aria-label: A six-step ladder, bottom to top: suggest, draft, propose with plan, gated apply, supervised autonomy, unattended.

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Bradley Hand, Comic Sans MS, cursive

g.font-family: Segoe Print, Bradley Hand, Comic Sans MS, cursive
g.text: 1 · suggest: agent proposes text, human types
2 · draft: agent writes files, human reads every line
3 · propose with plan: agent writes code + plan, human reads the plan
4 · gated apply: automated checks + human approval
5 · supervised: agent loops, human reviews outcomes
6 · unattended: agent runs to a stop condition, human reviews exceptions

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Bradley Hand, Comic Sans MS, cursive

svg.text: no step is safe without the gate beside it
